claim: The companion-app clear_notification contract is documented verbatim: 'You can clear an existing notification which has a tag by sending clear_notification' — message: "clear_notification" plus the original tag in data (iOS requires app 2021.5+); notifications are replaced, not cleared, by reusing a tag.
stance_target: go-hass-agent issue #926's report that clear_notification 'simply sends a second notification instead' is a deviation from the documented companion-app semantics
scope_conditions: mobile_app notify platform; notifications carrying a tag
quoted_support: Replacing: Replace an existing notification by using a tag for the notification. All subsequent notifications will take the place of a notification with the same tag. ... Clearing: You can clear an existing notification which has a tag by sending clear_notification. ... message: "clear_notification" ... data: tag: "backyard-motion-detected"
numbers: iOS requires app version 2021.5 or later

claim: The mobile_app notify platform requires at least message: in the payload, exposes each device as a notify.mobile_app_<device_id> target, and supports group: for visual grouping — the base schema shared by all companion-app notification features.
stance_target: Baseline notification schema for any agent adopting the mobile_app protocol
quoted_support: The mobile_app notify platform accepts the standard title, message and target parameters used by the notify platform. ... A requirement of the notify platform is that you must specify at least message: in your payload.
